Section(s): An improved model including glucose and fructose enables the prediction of cell growth at low sucrose concentrations

Text and equations in reading order:
    Time trajectories of measured and predicted data (continuous line) for the initial model validation representing the cultivation of BY-2 cells under optimal (experiments #4 and #5) and non-optimal (experiments #6 and #7) conditions (A–D) Iteration 2. Measurement uncertainty made of a constant and proportional component (Table S4). A, ammonium; F, fructose; G, glucose; N, nitrate; P, phosphate; S, sucrose; V, volume; X, cell dry mass. See Table S3 for measured initial values.
(19) \begin{align*}V\frac{dF}{dt}+F\frac{dV}{dt}&=m_{SF}\alpha\left(\frac{S}{S+K_{S}}\frac{K_{IS}}{S+K_{IS}}\right)X_{a}V\\&\quad-\mu_{F}\left(\frac{F}{F+K_{F}}\frac{K_{IF}}{F+K_{IF}}\right)X_{a}V\end{align*}    [code: ODE, computes F, code proposes balance]
(20) \begin{align*}V\frac{dG}{dt}+G\frac{dV}{dt}&=m_{SG}\alpha\Bigg(\frac{S}{S+K_{S}}\frac{K_{IS}}{S+K_{IS}}\Bigg)X_{a}V\\&\quad-\mu_{G}\Bigg(\frac{G}{G+K_{G}}\frac{K_{IG}}{G+K_{IG}}\Bigg)X_{a}V\end{align*}    [code: ODE, computes G, code proposes balance]
    The sucrose to glucose or fructose DM conversion parameters ( $ m_{SG} $ and $ m_{SF} $) were set at 0.526 because one mole of sucrose always produces one mole each of glucose and fructose (Puad et al., 2017). This model is defined hereafter as the “improved model”. It has 20 parameters to identify, including the death rate constant $ k_d $, maximum specific growth rate $ \mu_m $, maximum specific growth rate for ammonium and phosphate $ \mu^A_m $, $ \mu^P_m $, saturation and inhibition constants $ K_h $ and $ K_{lh} $, hydrolysis constant $ \alpha $, and consumption rates $ \mu_h $. Coefficie...

Symbols:
  V: V is the volume of the cultivation medium. [L] (computed)
  F: Fructose concentration (computed)
  m_{SF}: sucrose to glucose or fructose DM conversion parameter [-] (parameter)
  \alpha: Sucrose hydrolysis constant [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  S: S is the sucrose concentration. [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  K_{S}: K_S is the sucrose saturation constant. [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IS}: K_IS is the sucrose inhibition constant. [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  X_{a}: X_a is the viable (active) cell dry mass. [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  \mu_{F}: Fructose consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{F}: Fructose saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IF}: Fructose inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  G: Glucose concentration (computed)
  m_{SG}: Sucrose to glucose or fructose dry mass conversion parameter [-] (parameter)
  \mu_{G}: Glucose consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{G}: Monod saturation constant for glucose (parameter)
  K_{IG}: Glucose inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM).

Laws: 19, 20
